findings.title: Withheld-branch gating order lets v4 annotations pass the legacy published/not_withheld paths
findings.accepted: Explicit v4 discriminator must validate strict exclusive metadata before permitting withheld comments: exact version/reason, no scope, zero active/adjustments, bounded contiguous original entries. Add malformed-version/reason/active-pool counterexamples.
findings.rejected: The claimed legacy not_withheld eligibility is contradicted by the supplied expression and by the reviewer own reproduction. There is no outer report-v4 type that can be routed through a version1 pool; version lives only in the actual disposition. Existing v1-v3 semantics remain unchanged by requirement.

findings.title: Pool-less v4 report with nonempty active risks has no explicit rule; legacy handling would publish and repair them
findings.reason: A pool-less v4-typed report is not a representable state: there is no report-level v4 marker or v4 item status. Without the new disposition, a package is a legacy report and must preserve legacy import behavior. New source publication always writes its nonempty v4 disposition. A v4 marker or v4 reason on malformed metadata will be explicitly blocked at the repair namespace. No validator can infer removed provenance or prove original provider authenticity.

findings.title: Exact-citation requirement does not constrain raw wording placement; only image-gap rows are disclosed
findings.action: Use a distinct v4 neutral entry renderer, never assessmentRiskPresentation. Keep raw title, explanation, suggestion AND exact citations together inside one explicitly unverified original-wording disclosure; human comments outside it. Assert disclosure nesting and no linked repair with real component SSR.

acceptance: All otherwise unbound source optional leads enter v4; no active risk remains
Items/statuses and all original risk data/order/citations remain unchanged
No invented per-risk obligation, owner, observed visibility or adjustment
Exact export/review/repair namespaces reject forged v4 metadata without broadening legacy contracts
Three original first-answer captures replay with explicit new publication accounting; original files unchanged
